textbookBox.concept: In the villages of Anand district in Gujarat, farmers used to cycle or walk to nearby villages to sell milk in the scorching heat. If the milk spoiled, it was lost, and middlemen bought it cheaply.

textbookBox.concept: As societies progressed, the number of economic activities by which people earn a living grew. They are grouped into three main sectors: primary, secondary and tertiary.

beats.en: Farmers in Anand had to sell their milk quickly before it spoiled, so they depended on middlemen, who bought milk in bulk at low prices and sold it in the market.
